description: Article-contract observation profile: only CHPDT (cumulative dry fruit weight) enters formal Phi, transformed via ln(y+1). CHFPW (cumulative fresh fruit weight) is diagnostic-only for DMC/fresh-dry ratio interpretation. LAID/LWAD/SWAD are process diagnostics. PWAD, PWAI, HWAM are explicitly forbidden — their observation definitions do not match continuous-harvest eggplant. Original FileA/FileT values are always preserved on the physical scale; the transform applies only to the values copied into PestHarvest.OUT and the PEST control file.
forbidden_rationale: PWAD/PWAI are single-harvest partition variables incompatible with continuous-harvest eggplant. HWAM is an indeterminate-crop at-harvest aggregate that cannot represent incremental CHPDT. Using any of these as Phi targets would conflate harvest-structure errors with genetic-parameter errors.
